# Backlog Refinement scope

Use this scope to refine one user story for an existing product. It investigates
the current implementation, resolves questions with the person, creates a
reviewable screen prototype, and produces a mapping that developers can use to
plan implementation. The human decides product behavior and approves the final
mockup and map.

## Membership

Keyword triggers: `backlog refinement`, `refine user story`, `story refinement`,
`prepare story for implementation`. Reverse Engineering, Requirements Analysis,
and User Stories inspect the existing implementation and clarify the story.
The plugin then creates a browser-viewable prototype, captures a screenshot for
review, and produces the implementation map after the mockup is approved.
